body:
Mula v1.2.49 hanggang v1.2.59: i-install lang ang update, hindi na kailangang i-uninstall.
Mula v1.2.48 o mas luma: i-uninstall muna ang lumang E-Tarabay. Babalik ang stars, awards at progress pagka-sign in ulit.

From v1.2.49 to v1.2.59: just install the update. From v1.2.48 or older: uninstall the old E-Tarabay first; your stars, awards and progress come back when you sign in.

I-download / Download: https://jaijr711.github.io/etarabay-releases/

Pagka-update

- Wala nang kailangang gawin.

Mga Ayos

- Ang mga video kung paano maglaro sa Bilang at sa Masayang Pagkukulay ay tunog na lang ng laro, walang boses, gaya ng iba pang video.

---

After updating

- Nothing to do.

Fixes

- The how-to-play videos in Numbers and Color Fun now have only the game's own sounds, no voice, like the other videos.
